text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Trainer! I'm back.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Haha, thank you. It was a really<n>fantastic race.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Maybe it's because no one wanted<n>to mess up in
such a big event, but<n>the other runners used slightly
different strategies than they had in<n>the past.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
We'll need to factor that into our<n>strategy going
forward. Let's talk<n>about it on our way home.
Starting<n>with what happened at the gate...

We discuss different adjustments to<n>include in her
calculations all the way<n>back to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Oh, we're back already. That was<n>fast.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
But since we've come up with so<n>many ideas, I'd
like to give some of<n>them a try.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Fortunately, we still have some time<n>until curfew.
choice_data_list: Okay, but let's try to keep it short.
Okay, but let's try to keep it short.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hehe, all right. Thanks for helping<n>with this.

Biwa Hayahide and I start heading<n>toward the
training course, when...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hm? Isn't that...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Geh...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Taishin! Are you okay?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Tch... I'm fine. I can keep going.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
You saw Hayahide's race. She was<n>amazing. I
want to win harder than<n>ever, but...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: All I've been hearing about is howgreat she is or how she'sunbeatable. It's so annoying!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: They're all just saying that becausethey've never seen me run!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Taishin...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Wait! Taishiiin!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Well, I'm not gonna lose to either ofyou!

text_block_list.name: The Two
text_block_list.text: RAAAH! AAAAH!

Whenever one of them pulls ahead,<n>the other
immediately pushes<n>forward. Neither of them
relents as<n>their race continues.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: They both run so amazingly...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ticket is tenacious and persists at full<n>speed until
the very end... And the<n>ferocity of Taishin's pursuit
is<n>unparalleled.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Both of them are first-class<n>competitors in their own
right.<n>They're incredible.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, I know I was the one who<n>asked to come out
here, but...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Can we try out our calculations<n>another time? If
they see me now,<n>well...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Thank you... You've been nothing but
accommodating today.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Um, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I wanted to discuss my future plans...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I believe I should take on the Classic<n>Triple Crown
tour as the next step of<n>my journey.

It consists of the Satsuki Sho, the<n>Japanese Derby,
and the Kikuka Sho.

And, just like the Japanese Derby,<n>each one can
only be challenged once<n>in a racer's life.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I want to perfect my winning equation<n>so I can be
the greatest of my<n>generation.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Barring that, I at least want to be an<n>Umamusume
like none other.<n>Otherwise, there's no way I can
ever<n>hope to compete with Brian.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
And in order to reach that goal, I'll<n>inevitably need
to confront Ticket and<n>Taishin head-on.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Do I have your support in this<n>endeavor?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hehe! Thank you. I knew I could<n>count on you.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to become the greatest<n>Umamusume of
all time. One that<n>neither Ticket nor Taishin nor
anyone<n>else can beat.

Biwa Hayahide's words cement her<n>decision to
enter the Satsuki Sho, the<n>first race of the Classic
Triple Crown<n>tour.
